info.longBusinessSummary: Wistron Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of information technology products in the United States, Europe, China, and internationally. The company develops and produces desktop computers, notebook computers, motherboards, servers, system platforms, multi-CPU computer systems, multimedia computers, network computers, consumer computers, micro-processors, CD-ROMs, PDAs, panel PCs, pocket computers, and interface cards. It also offers professional display systems, industrial PCs, and data storage equipment. The company provides video and internet telephones, video conferencing equipment, telecommunication equipment, VoIP systems, wireless receiver products including mobile phones, wireless LAN cards, and Bluetooth communication modules, as well as networking and communication products. Its consumer electronics offerings include digital satellite TV receivers, set-top boxes, digital video decoders, multimedia appliance products, LCD TVs, electronic audio and visual products, digital cameras, and CD-ROM and DVD-ROM drives. The company also manufactures, processes, and sells automotive electronics and telematics products. In addition, the company designs and merchandises computer software and programs; recycles electronic waste; and offers in vitro diagnostic devices, therapeutic equipment, intelligent assistive devices, diagnostic x-ray units, physiological signal diagnostic devices, and medical data systems. Further, it is involved in the maintenance and cleaning of electronics products; import and export trade business; sale and maintenance of computer products and related parts and components, data storage equipment, and digital monitoring systems; internet platform development; provision and sale of application services and consultation; and repair of electronic products. Wistron Corporation was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
